spriteComponent.name: Sprite
spriteComponent.event:
component:GetVar("spriteName"):Set("$sign")
if(game:firstLoad() ~= 0) then component("visible"):SetInt(0) else component("visible"):SetInt(1) end

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
component:GetVar("alignment"):SetInt(8) component:GetVar("font"):Set(lua_game.getButtonFont()) local signString = ("LEVEL " .. (game:level() + 1)) signString = signString component:GetVar("text"):Set(signString)
if(game:firstLoad() ~= 0) then component("visible"):SetInt(0) else component("visible"):SetInt(1) end

template.event: element:GetVar("time"):SetFloat(element:GetVar("time"):GetFloat() + dt) if(element:GetVar("time"):GetFloat() >= 0 and element:GetVar("time"):GetFloat() > element:GetVar("staticduration"):GetFloat()) then if(element:GetVar("fadeduration"):GetFloat() > element:GetVar("time"):GetFloat() - element:GetVar("staticduration"):GetFloat()) then local t = 1.0 - (element:GetVar("time"):GetFloat() - element:GetVar("staticduration"):GetFloat())/element:GetVar("fadeduration"):GetFloat() if(0 > t) then t = 0 end element:GetComponent("Sprite"):GetVar("alpha"):SetFloat(t) element:GetComponent("Text"):GetVar("alpha"):SetFloat(t) element:GetVar("Y"):SetFloat(element:GetVar("Y"):GetFloat() - dt*lua_sys.screenHeight()/8.0) else element:GetComponent("Sprite"):GetVar("visible"):SetInt(0) element:GetComponent("Text"):GetVar("visible"):SetInt(0) element("active"):SetInt(0) end end
